searchDocs.title: Version​
searchDocs.content: </> type Version = { major: number, minor: number, patch: number } Primitive datatype that represents a deconstructed version, split up into their respective components.

searchDocs.title: ConvertibleVersion​
searchDocs.content: </> type ConvertibleVersion = Version | string Abstracted datatype allowing you to either pass a deconstructed Version, or a semver string that will then be deconstructed.

searchDocs.title: parse​
searchDocs.content: </> CarrotCore.parse(version: Version) → Version Parses a version string, and deconstructs it into a format usable with the framework.

searchDocs.title: satisfies​
searchDocs.content: </> CarrotCore.satisfies( version: ConvertibleVersion, requirement: string ) → boolean Checks if a specific version fits a semver range requirement

searchDocs.title: format​
searchDocs.content: </> CarrotCore.format(version: Version) → string Reconstructs a Version table back into a semver string
